about: Every data source Lumo uses or can use, what it proves, and how Lumo reaches it. Status: live = called from the browser when a listing opens; bundled = a saved copy inside Lumo; key = needs a free key in Settings; planned = not wired in yet.

sources.name: Microburbs API
sources.access: api.microburbs.com.au, key in Settings (free 'test' key covers Bondi and a few other suburbs)
powers: rent history and relisting (with a full key)

sources.name: NSW Planning Portal: online DA data (since 2019)
sources.access: api.apps1.nsw.gov.au/eplanning/data/v0/OnlineDA, no key. Filtered by council and lodgement date, then by distance. Waverley is also bundled (data/da-waverley.json) for a fast demo.

sources.name: NSW Spatial Services (NSW Government)
sources.access: portal.spatial.nsw.gov.au ArcGIS REST, no key. Train, metro and light rail stations (Features of Interest), and council boundaries.

sources.name: ABS Census 2021
sources.access: data.api.abs.gov.au (SDMX), no key. Table G02 by postcode.
powers: rent as a share of local income

sources.name: City of Sydney open data
sources.access: services1.arcgis.com City of Sydney FeatureServers, no key. Only inside the City of Sydney council area.
powers: council street lights on the night walk

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.access: Overpass API (several mirrors, raced) and OSRM foot routing (routing.openstreetmap.de). Bondi Junction to Bondi Beach is bundled (data/osm-east.json) for when Overpass is down.

sources.name: Overture Maps places
sources.access: Release 2026-10-21, Greater Sydney, saved in data/places-sydney.json (6,244 places: gyms, supermarkets, pubs and bars, stations).

sources.name: Mapillary
sources.access: graph.mapillary.com, free client token from mapillary.com/developer, paste in Settings.
powers: recent street-level photos around the home

sources.name: Google Maps
sources.access: Links work with no key (directions, Street View). Routes API key in Settings gives real transit times.

sources.name: NSW Valuer General bulk sales
sources.access: Weekly bulk sales files from valuergeneral.nsw.gov.au (blocked from our build server; download by hand and convert).
powers: last sale price of the building

sources.name: Digital Atlas of Australia
powers: national hazard layers (flood, bushfire) outside Microburbs coverage

sources.name: Digital Earth Australia
powers: tree cover and heat from satellite

sources.name: data.gov.au
sources.access: data.gov.au CKAN catalogue: where to find council datasets (street lights, parking, noise) for other councils.
powers: finding more council layers to add
